title: Current Source Editor baseline
summary: The accepted delivered baseline remains oorexx_source_editor_v0.1-dev5. Git now contains a dev8 candidate. Dev6 routes backup/live publication through oorexx.atomic-file/0.1 dev1 with FULL durability requested; dev7 adds native ooRexx multi-word find/grep argument semantics; dev8 adds lexical/source-aware document/tree reference navigation with declaration/reference classification. Fresh r13196 + Atomic File native-provider qualification remains required before promotion.
invariants: Implementation remains native ooRexx; do not move semantic ownership into Python.
Literal find stays literal; regex grep uses ooRexx RegularExpression semantics.
Recursive file traversal uses ooRexx/RexxUtil facilities rather than an external find subprocess.
Source results retain original path/line/column and enclosing-symbol provenance where available.
User-visible completion order is deterministic and must not depend on Directory iteration order.
Dev8 must not be called accepted until the full r13196 + Atomic File native-provider suite passes.
